subject: Jev: A Fresh Look at AI Classification
body:
Hello First Name,

Our 🦄 ai that works session this week was all about "Jev: A Fresh Look at AI Classification"!

You can find the full recording, code, and diagrams from the session on GitHub:
https://github.com/hellovai/ai-that-works

We dove deep into Jev and how it impacts agent architecture and classification. Here's a quick rundown of what we covered:

*   **Jev is a "System One" Model, Not a Traditional LLM:** Unlike traditional LLMs that process token streams, Jev outputs probabilities for specific, constrained choices (like enums), scores, or simple binary outcomes. This "single token" approach makes it incredibly efficient and cost-effective, making it a true 'System One' AI.
*   **New Agent Architectures:** Jev offers a powerful alternative for classification, routing, and quick decision-making. It lets you swap out slower, pricier LLMs for these specific tasks, significantly reducing latency and cost. We saw examples like 8x faster processing and 90% accuracy (compared to a 50% LLM baseline for Rippling!).
*   **New Possibilities for Software Design:** Jev's speed and affordability open up interesting new avenues. Think about building more responsive systems and writing cleaner, more reactive code. This could mean dynamic logic with `dot_feels`, real-time git log filtering, or even sophisticated state-transition-based coding agents.

The main takeaway from this session is:
Jev isn't just another model; it's a distinct class of "System One" AI. It's built for fast, cost-effective, and accurate classification, changing how we approach designing and building AI agents. This allows for rapid, high-frequency decision loops and opens up new software possibilities.

We also had a fascinating session last week about "Optimizing LLM Workflows" for efficiency and cost. You can find the video, whiteboards, and code for that on GitHub too!

Our next session tomorrow will be all about "Building an AI Content Pipeline." We'll explore how to use an AI pipeline to generate content, like summaries or emails, from zoom recordings and transcripts.

If you have any questions, just reply to this email or ask on Discord: https://www.boundaryml.com/discord. We read all your messages! Happy coding 🧑‍💻

Vaibhav & Dex
